title: Foundations on frozen soil.
officialText:
Shallow foundations shall not bear on frozen soil.
Exception: Temporary structures may bear on frozen soil if the soil is maintained in a frozen condition throughout the service
life of the temporary structures being supported. The method of maintaining the soil in a frozen condition shall be approved
by the commissioner.
